import AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Probability.OrthogonalHaar
import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Measure.Real
import Mathlib.Tactic.FunProp
import Mathlib.Tactic.Linarith
import Mathlib.Tactic.NormNum

/-!
# Actual determinant-component Haar probabilities

Zhou--Suzuki arXiv:2610.20492v1, Appendix B.2.2 first proof paragraph
before Eq20. The source asserts half-mass without spelling out its elementary
symmetry proof. This supplies that background and literal restriction-law
normalization, explicitly generalized from the application n>=3 to n>=1.
Actual Gaussian target mixtures, TV and both query lower bounds remain separate.
-/

open Matrix MeasureTheory Set
open scoped ENNReal
open AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Probability.OrthogonalHaar

namespace AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.GaussianComplexity.DeterminantComponents

theorem component_probabilities {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) :
    let μ := orthogonalHaar n
    let Cpos : Set (Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ) :=
      {O | (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).det = 1}
    let Cneg : Set (Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ) :=
      {O | (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).det = -1}
    μ Cpos = (2 : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ ∧ μ Cneg = (2 : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ ∧
    IsProbabilityMeasure ((2 : ℝ≥0∞) • μ.restrict Cpos) ∧
    IsProbabilityMeasure ((2 : ℝ≥0∞) • μ.restrict Cneg) := by
  classical
  dsimp only
  let μ := orthogonalHaar n
  let G := Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ
  let Cpos : Set G := {O | (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).det = 1}
  let Cneg : Set G := {O | (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).det = -1}
  let := (orthogonalHaar_spec n).1
  have hcont : Continuous (fun O : G => (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).det) := by
    fun_prop
  have hpos : MeasurableSet Cpos := (isClosed_eq hcont continuous_const).measurableSet
  have hsign (O : G) : (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).det = 1 ∨
      (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).det = -1 := by
    have h := congrArg Matrix.det
      ((Matrix.mem_orthogonalGroup_iff (Fin n) ℝ).mp O.property)
    rw [Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_transpose, Matrix.det_one] at h
    exact mul_self_eq_one_iff.mp h
  let i : Fin n := ⟨0, hn⟩
  let R : G := ⟨Matrix.diagonal (fun j => if j = i then (-1 : ℝ) else 1), by
    apply (Matrix.mem_orthogonalGroup_iff (Fin n) ℝ).2
    rw [Matrix.diagonal_transpose, Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal]
    have heq : (fun j : Fin n => (if j = i then (-1 : ℝ) else 1) *
        (if j = i then (-1 : ℝ) else 1)) = fun _ => (1 : ℝ) := by
      funext j
      by_cases hj : j = i <;> simp [hj]
    rw [heq, Matrix.diagonal_one]⟩
  have hR : (R : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).det = -1 := by
    simp [R, Matrix.det_diagonal]
  have hswap : (fun O : G => R * O) ⁻¹' Cpos = Cneg := by
    ext O
    change ((R : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) *
      (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)).det = 1 ↔
        (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).det = -1
    rw [Matrix.det_mul, hR, neg_one_mul]
    constructor <;> intro h <;> linarith
  have hequal : μ Cpos = μ Cneg := by
    calc
      μ Cpos = (μ.map (fun O : G => R * O)) Cpos := by
        rw [orthogonalHaar_map_mul_left]
      _ = μ ((fun O : G => R * O) ⁻¹' Cpos) :=
        Measure.map_apply (by fun_prop) hpos
      _ = μ Cneg := by rw [hswap]
  have hcompl : Cposᶜ = Cneg := by
    ext O
    change ¬ (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).det = 1 ↔
      (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).det = -1
    rcases hsign O with h | h <;> norm_num [h]
  have hadd : μ Cpos + μ Cneg = 1 := by
    rw [← hcompl, measure_add_measure_compl hpos]
    exact measure_univ
  have hp : μ Cpos = (2 : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ := by
    apply (ENNReal.toReal_eq_toReal_iff' (measure_ne_top μ Cpos) (by simp)).mp
    have h := congrArg ENNReal.toReal hadd
    rw [ENNReal.toReal_add (measure_ne_top μ Cpos) (measure_ne_top μ Cneg),
      ← hequal] at h
    norm_num at h ⊢
    linarith
  have hm : μ Cneg = (2 : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ := hequal.symm.trans hp
  refine ⟨hp, hm, ⟨?_⟩, ⟨?_⟩⟩
  · rw [Measure.smul_apply, Measure.restrict_apply_univ, hp]
    exact ENNReal.mul_inv_cancel (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  · rw [Measure.smul_apply, Measure.restrict_apply_univ, hm]
    exact ENNReal.mul_inv_cancel (by norm_num) (by norm_num)

end AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.GaussianComplexity.DeterminantComponents

steps.title: Identify the actual two Borel events
steps.text: The determinant is continuous on real matrices and hence on O(n), so its level sets are Borel. Orthogonality gives det(O)^2=1. Over the reals this says det(O)=1 or det(O)=-1, with disjoint alternatives. Thus Cminus is exactly the complement of Cplus.
steps.lean: Continuity, determinant product/transpose and mul_self_eq_one_iff produce the measurable partition; it is not a caller premise.

steps.title: Construct a sign-changing symmetry in positive dimension
steps.text: Because n>=1, the zeroth coordinate exists. Negate that coordinate and fix the others. The diagonal matrix R is orthogonal, its determinant is -1, and det(RO)=-det(O). Consequently the preimage of Cplus under left multiplication by R is Cminus.
steps.lean: The proof constructs R as a local actual orthogonal matrix and proves its determinant and preimage identity internally. No reflection witness is supplied by the caller.

steps.title: Use the same canonical full-Haar invariance
steps.text: Left multiplication by the fixed R preserves the identical full-Haar probability already used elsewhere. Applying the map-measure formula to the Borel event Cplus and substituting the preimage identity yields equality of the two component masses. This elementary argument supplies the justification omitted from the source paragraph.
steps.lean: The proof calls the exact compiled orthogonalHaar_map_mul_left and Measure.map_apply. The source omission stays explicit; no distinct Haar or SO law is introduced.

steps.title: Solve the mass equation using actual probability
steps.text: The events partition the whole group and mu is a probability measure, so their masses sum to1. Combining equal masses with this identity gives each mass1/2. In Lean, finiteness permits a faithful ENNReal-to-real calculation and injectivity returns the ENNReal equality; no infinite-value cancellation is used.
steps.lean: The exact orthogonalHaar_spec probability, measure_add_measure_compl, measure_ne_top and finite toReal equality discharge normalization.

reconstruction.text: For every natural number n with n > 0, let O(n) be the full group of real n by n orthogonal matrices, equipped with its inherited matrix Borel structure, and let mu be its canonical Haar probability measure, obtained by the Haar construction normalized on the whole group. Define C_plus = {O in O(n) : det(O) = 1} and C_minus = {O in O(n) : det(O) = -1}. Then mu(C_plus) = 1/2 and mu(C_minus) = 1/2, with these values interpreted in the extended nonnegative reals. Furthermore, each of the actual measures nu_plus = 2 times (mu restricted to C_plus) and nu_minus = 2 times (mu restricted to C_minus), on the original carrier O(n), is a probability measure. Explicitly, for every Borel set A in O(n), nu_plus(A) = 2 mu(A intersect C_plus) and nu_minus(A) = 2 mu(A intersect C_minus), and nu_plus(O(n)) = nu_minus(O(n)) = 1. All four assertions are conclusions under the sole non-typing hypothesis n > 0. In particular, the result includes n = 1 and makes no assertion for n = 0.
